Step_Or_Surface: Step 1: Signup form submit (orgName + email + password)
Trigger: User submits the signup form at /signup
Behaviour: handleSubmit() calls supabase.auth.signUp({email,password,options:{emailRedirectTo:`${window.location.origin}/auth/callback`}}). Password minLength=6 enforced client-side only via the Input attribute.
Failure_Mode: signUpError renders inline via setError(signUpError.message); loading resets, no retry, no logging.
Gap_Or_Risk: Password policy is a client-side minLength=6 only; no strength/complexity rule is enforced in this file. orgName is not validated beyond HTML `required`.

Behaviour: R48_SIGNUP_UNCOMPLETABLE_01 comment: without emailRedirectTo the link falls back to the Supabase project's Site URL and the credential is dropped silently.
Failure_Mode: If the Supabase redirect allowlist does not contain the deployment origin, Supabase rejects the redirect and the user lands nowhere useful.
Gap_Or_Risk: The allowlist is Supabase-project config, not in this repo. UNKNOWN whether production origins are allowlisted. Not verifiable from the codebase.

Behaviour: Stashes the org name in browser localStorage under key `projexa_pending_org_name`, shows a 'check your email' card, and defers all org creation.
Failure_Mode: If the user confirms on a different device/browser, or clears site data, or uses private browsing, the pending org name is gone forever.
Gap_Or_Risk: HIGH: org identity is carried in localStorage, not server state. A user who confirms email on their phone gets an authenticated account with NO organization and no way to name one - every API route then answers 'No organization'.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 2: POST /api/org/provision - the only place PROJEXA creates an org row
Behaviour: Wrapped in withTiming('POST'). Requires body.orgName (trimmed, non-empty) else 400 'orgName is required'.
Failure_Mode: Missing/blank orgName -> 400. Malformed JSON -> req.json().catch(()=>null) -> orgName undefined -> 400.
Gap_Or_Risk: No length cap, no uniqueness check, and no character validation on orgName beyond trim.

Behaviour: createClient() + getClaimsWithRetry(supabase); userId = data.claims.sub. No requireAuth()/requireRole() - the caller by definition has no org yet.
Failure_Mode: error || !data?.claims -> 401 Unauthorized.
Gap_Or_Risk: Any authenticated Supabase user can provision an org and thereby mint a real VERIDIAN tenant. No rate limit on the PROJEXA side (only the backend's per-application 20/min).

Trigger: User already has any memberships row
Behaviour: Returns {organizationId, alreadyProvisioned:true, veridianConnected:<bool>} and, when veridianConnected is false, adds {repairRequired:true, repairPath:'/api/org/repair'}.
Failure_Mode: R48 UAT note in-file: this used to answer a flat alreadyProvisioned:true, which hid the half-provisioned state entirely.
Gap_Or_Risk: Guard is 'has ANY membership', not 'has a membership in a healthy org'. An invitee who accepted an invite into someone else's org can never provision their own.

Trigger: provision or repair route calls provisionVeridianOrg()
Behaviour: Reads process.env.VERIDIAN_PLATFORM_APPLICATION_KEY. If unset, throws VeridianApiError('VERIDIAN_PLATFORM_APPLICATION_KEY is not configured -- cannot provision a new VERIDIAN org for this signup', 500).
Failure_Mode: Every signup fails with a 500-derived message; no PROJEXA rows are written (ordering is VERIDIAN-first by design).
Gap_Or_Risk: Single env var is a hard single point of failure for ALL customer onboarding. Its absence is only discoverable at signup time - no startup check, no health endpoint reads it.

Behaviour: POST to `${VERIDIAN_API_ROOT}/platform/provision-org` with Authorization: Bearer <platformKey>, Content-Type: application/json, cache:'no-store'. Body: {customerOrgName, country?, primaryCurrency?} - optional keys omitted entirely when absent.
Failure_Mode: !res.ok -> throwForResponse(res, durationMs). Response missing organisationId or apiKey -> VeridianApiError('VERIDIAN provision-org returned an unexpected response shape', 502).
Gap_Or_Risk: VERIDIAN_API_ROOT is derived by stripping '/projexa' from VERIDIAN_API_BASE_URL, which defaults to a hardcoded https://veridian-compliance-ai.vercel.app/... - a misconfigured base URL silently retargets provisioning.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 3b: Transport budget applied to provisioning
Behaviour: VERIDIAN_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000; VERIDIAN_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS = 9_000. Explicit AbortController + setTimeout (NOT AbortSignal.timeout(), which never fires on Bun 1.3.14 Windows per the file header).
Failure_Mode: Timeout -> VeridianApiError code UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT. Connection failure (ECONNRESET/ECONNREFUSED/ENOTFOUND) -> code NETWORK, 502, 'Couldn''t reach the construction data service. Please retry.'
Gap_Or_Risk: Org provisioning shares the same 8s budget as ordinary reads even though it does far more work upstream (org + department + fiscal year + accounts + branch enablement + key mint). A slow-but-successful upstream provision can time out on the PROJEXA side, orphaning a real VERIDIAN org.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 4: Backend auth - platform application key
Behaviour: validatePlatformApplicationKey(): requires 'Bearer ' prefix AND token starting with 'pk_'; hashSHA256(token) looked up against platformApplications.keyHash on the raw RLS-bypassing db client; row must exist and isActive.
Failure_Mode: Any failure returns {status:'invalid'} -> route answers 401 Unauthorized with no detail.
Gap_Or_Risk: Deliberately disjoint from customer vk_ keys. No key expiry, no rotation mechanism, and no last-used tracking visible in this file - a leaked pk_ key is valid until someone flips isActive.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 4a: Backend rate limit on provisioning
Behaviour: PROVISION_MAX_PER_WINDOW=20, PROVISION_WINDOW_MS=60_000, tracked in an in-process Map keyed by platformApp.id.
Failure_Mode: Over limit -> 429 with Retry-After: 60.
Gap_Or_Risk: In-process and per-warm-instance by the file's own admission ('on serverless it bounds a single warm instance rather than the fleet'). Not a real global quota; a burst signup wave across instances is unbounded.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 4b: Backend body validation and defaults
Behaviour: customerOrgName required (trimmed string) else 400. country defaults to 'IN'; primaryCurrency defaults to 'INR'.
Failure_Mode: Invalid JSON -> 400 'Invalid JSON body'. Blank customerOrgName -> 400.
Gap_Or_Risk: PROJEXA's /api/org/provision NEVER sends country or primaryCurrency (it passes only customerOrgName). So every org created via signup is stamped country='IN'/currency='INR' regardless of the customer's actual country - the exact defect org-provisioning-service.ts documents as live in production (UAE entities given Indian GST/TDS).

Behaviour: Looks up productBranches by branchKey === platformApp.applicationKey; if absent, INSERTs a new row {branchKey, displayName, domain, status:'live'} on the raw db client.
Failure_Mode: UNKNOWN - no explicit catch around this lookup/insert other than the outer try.
Gap_Or_Risk: A typo'd or renamed applicationKey silently creates a brand-new product branch rather than failing, so orgs can be tagged to a branch nobody intended.

Behaviour: Creates the organisation + default 'General' department + the 2 free branches (veri_reward, veri_chat_v2). Slug uniqueness loop runs on getProvisioningDb() (elevated), NOT `db`, because compliance.organisations has FORCED RLS and app_runtime outside tenant context matches no rows. Gives up after 20 collision attempts.
Failure_Mode: Attempt>20 -> breaks out and the INSERT then hits the unique constraint -> unhandled 500. Documented real production failure 2026-08-26 (slug=meridian-interiors-llc).
Gap_Or_Risk: Two customers with similar names still collide after 20 tries. Plan is hardcoded 'free' with a $20/mo AI cost cap (defaultMonthlyCostCapUsdForPlan) - there is no paid-signup path at all.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 4e: Required product-branch enablement for PROJEXA
Behaviour: REQUIRED_BRANCHES_BY_APPLICATION.projexa = ['construction','erp','sales','hr']. Inserted into orgProductBranchEnablements under withTenantContext({orgId}).
Failure_Mode: Wrapped in its own try/catch and explicitly NON-FATAL: console.warn(...'(non-fatal)') and provisioning continues.
Gap_Or_Risk: HIGH: a silent branch-enablement failure yields a signup that reports 201 success but whose new org 502s across Vendors, Materials, Accounting, Invoices, Payroll, Budgets, Sales Dashboard, Leads, Customers, Opportunities, Quotations and Sales Orders (requireErpEnabled/requireSalesEnabled). Nothing surfaces this to the customer or to PROJEXA.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 4f: Minting the per-org vk_ API key
Behaviour: generateApiKey() + hashSHA256() + keyPrefix = rawKey.substring(0,8)+'...'. Inserted into apiKeys under withTenantContext({orgId}) with name `${displayName} (provisioned)`, scopes 'read,write', isActive true, issuedForApplicationId set.
Failure_Mode: UNKNOWN - a failure here falls to the outer catch -> generic 500, after the org already exists.
Gap_Or_Risk: The FULL key is returned ONLY in this 201 response and is never retrievable again. If PROJEXA's step 3 (credentials insert) then fails, that key is lost and the VERIDIAN org is unreachable - recovery requires provisioning an entirely new org via /api/org/repair.

Behaviour: 201 {organisationId, apiKey}. On error containing 'Organisation provisioning needs an elevated connection' -> 503 naming the missing env vars (PROVISIONING_DATABASE_URL, or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD). All other errors -> 500 'Failed to provision organisation'.
Failure_Mode: Generic 500 for every non-configuration failure; the real cause only reaches console.error.
Gap_Or_Risk: R53/R48_ORG_PROVISION_RLS_BLOCKED_01 in-file: this exact class of failure previously looked like 'a mystery outage for days'. Only the one configuration case is now named; every other cause is still opaque to the operator.

Step_Or_Surface: Step 5: PROJEXA org row insert (ordering is deliberate)
Behaviour: supabase.from('organizations').insert({name:orgName, slug:`${slugify(orgName)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`}) using the CALLER'S OWN session (RLS policies from drizzle/0003_signup_insert_policies.sql).
Failure_Mode: orgError -> console.error naming the orphaned VERIDIAN org id, then 500 with orgError.message.
Gap_Or_Risk: Documented tradeoff in-file: a failure here leaves one orphaned VERIDIAN org with nothing pointing at it. There is no reconciliation job that finds or reclaims those orgs.

Behaviour: supabase.from('memberships').insert({user_id:userId, organization_id:org.id, role:'owner'}).
Failure_Mode: membershipError -> console.error naming both org ids, then 500 with membershipError.message.
Gap_Or_Risk: Steps 5 and 6 are not transactional. A failure here leaves an organizations row with NO members - unreachable by anyone, and /api/org/repair cannot fix it (repair requires ctx.organizationId from a membership).

Behaviour: db.insert(veridianCredentials).values({organizationId, veridianOrgId, veridianApiKey}) via Drizzle's DIRECT Postgres connection - NOT the RLS-governed Supabase client, because public.veridian_credentials is locked to service_role only.
Failure_Mode: Throws -> 500 'Your account was created but we couldn''t finish connecting it to your workspace. Please contact support.' console.error asks 'is DATABASE_URL/SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD configured?'.
Gap_Or_Risk: THE half-provisioned state. Org + membership exist, credentials do not, and /api/org/provision's idempotency guard means re-running it can never fix this. In-file: 'the R48 demo tenant is in exactly this state ... veridian_credentials rows = 0'.

Behaviour: Prefers DATABASE_URL; else builds postgresql://postgres.<ref>:<SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD>@aws-1-ap-south-1.pooler.supabase.com:6543/postgres from NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL. postgres({prepare:false, ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}, max:1}).
Failure_Mode: Neither available -> throws 'No database connection string available. Set DATABASE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD.'
Gap_Or_Risk: ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false} disables certificate verification on the connection carrying every tenant's VERIDIAN API key. max:1 connection per instance is also a throughput ceiling on every credential lookup.

Behaviour: NextResponse.json({organizationId: org.id}, {status:201}). The VERIDIAN API key is deliberately never returned to the browser.
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: Caller (signup page) only checks res.ok, then router.push('/dashboard'). It does not verify veridianConnected on the success path.

Behaviour: One row per PROJEXA org. organizationId uuid PRIMARY KEY -> organizations.id ON DELETE CASCADE; veridianOrgId text NOT NULL UNIQUE; veridianApiKey text NOT NULL; createdAt/updatedAt timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now().
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: veridian_api_key is stored in PLAINTEXT text - not hashed, not encrypted at rest by the application. A read of this one table yields every tenant's live VERIDIAN credential.

Behaviour: CREATE TABLE ... ; ALTER TABLE public.veridian_credentials ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Explicit comment: 'No policies on veridian_credentials for anon/authenticated: it is readable only by the service_role key from trusted server code.'
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: Stated intent (service_role) and actual access path diverge: veridian-client.ts reads it through Drizzle's direct postgres superuser-class connection built from SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD, which bypasses RLS entirely rather than using service_role. RLS-with-no-policies is doing no work on that path.

Behaviour: ALTER TABLE public.veridian_credentials ADD CONSTRAINT veridian_credentials_veridian_org_id_unique UNIQUE (veridian_org_id). Verified 0 violations before applying.
Failure_Mode: A duplicate write now fails on the constraint instead of silently succeeding.
Gap_Or_Risk: In-file: without it, a race in /api/org/repair or /api/org/provision writing the same veridian_org_id for two PROJEXA orgs 'WOULD be a genuine cross-tenant leak' - compliance-tracker only ever sees veridian_org_id and has no visibility into PROJEXA's organization_id space.

Trigger: Any org-scoped VERIDIAN call, and both /api/org/repair branches
Behaviour: SELECT veridian_api_key FROM veridian_credentials WHERE organization_id = $1 LIMIT 1 via Drizzle. Returns row?.apiKey ?? null. NEVER throws.
Failure_Mode: On DB exception it console.errors and returns null - deliberately treating 'DB unreachable' identically to 'no row exists'.
Gap_Or_Risk: A transient DATABASE_URL/pooler outage is indistinguishable from a genuinely unprovisioned org. Downstream that becomes the AR-04 hard failure below, so a blip presents to the customer as a permanent misconfiguration. It also makes /api/org/repair's GET report repairAvailable:true for a healthy org.

Behaviour: 1) explicit options.apiKey wins; 2) else if options.organizationId -> getVeridianApiKey(); 3) else if process.env.VERIDIAN_API_KEY -> the shared key; else throws VeridianApiError('No VERIDIAN API key configured', 500).
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: An explicitly-passed options.apiKey bypasses the per-org lookup and the AR-04 guard entirely. Any call site that can supply an apiKey can act as an arbitrary tenant.

Trigger: organizationId WAS provided but getVeridianApiKey() returned null
Behaviour: THROWS VeridianApiError(`No VERIDIAN credentials configured for organization ${organizationId}, and per-org requests may not fall back to a shared key (AR-04)`, 500). It does NOT fall back to VERIDIAN_API_KEY.
Failure_Mode: Every single per-org VERIDIAN call for that org fails with a 500 - permanently, until credentials are supplied.
Gap_Or_Risk: Correct security posture (falling back would be cross-tenant leak E-45), but the resulting UX is a totally dead product with a raw 500 message. This is the state a half-provisioned org lives in, and nothing in the authenticated app surfaces 'your workspace is not connected' to the user.

Trigger: A call site that passes no organizationId at all
Behaviour: Falls through to process.env.VERIDIAN_API_KEY - the shared demo/sandbox key. File header: 'That shared key remains in use only as the key for calls that omit organizationId entirely (legacy call sites still being migrated).'
Failure_Mode: No error - the call succeeds against whatever tenant the shared key belongs to.
Gap_Or_Risk: OPEN MIGRATION: the AR-04 guard is defeated by simply not passing organizationId. UNKNOWN how many call sites still omit it - the codebase states the migration is incomplete but does not enumerate the remainder.

Trigger: Cached GETs for reference data (currencies, cost centers, fiscal years)
Behaviour: unstable_cache keyed on [cacheKey, path] PLUS organizationId as the wrapped function's sole argument - org-scoped two independent ways.
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: In-file warning: Next's ordinary fetch() cache keys on URL+method+body only, NOT headers - so adding `next:{revalidate}` to the shared fetch in fetchWithTimeout() 'would silently serve org A''s cached response to org B'. That is a live footgun for the next engineer who tries to speed up a VERIDIAN call.

Trigger: Authenticated org owner/admin polls the endpoint
Behaviour: requireAuth() then requireRole(ctx, ROLE_GROUPS.ORG_ADMIN). Returns {organizationId, veridianConnected: apiKey!==null, repairAvailable: apiKey===null}. Boolean only - the key value is never returned. export const dynamic='force-dynamic'.
Failure_Mode: requireAuth failure -> ctx.response. Wrong role -> requireRole's 403.
Gap_Or_Risk: Nothing in the app calls this automatically. The in-file rationale says it exists so a banner can distinguish 'not connected' from 'empty' - but no such banner was found wired to it. A broken org still looks merely empty.

Trigger: Owner/admin triggers repair on a half-provisioned org
Behaviour: Role-gated server-side. If getVeridianApiKey() already returns a key -> {repaired:false, alreadyHealthy:true} and changes NOTHING (never re-provisions, never rotates a live key). Otherwise reads organizations.name/.country and calls provisionVeridianOrg() with them.
Failure_Mode: Org read throws -> 503. Org row missing -> 409 'Your membership points at an organisation that no longer exists. This needs support, not a repair.' provisionVeridianOrg throws -> 502 or the VeridianApiError's own status.
Gap_Or_Risk: Requires an OWNER/ADMIN to already be signed in. A single-owner org whose owner cannot sign in (see PART C) can never be repaired. Also: repair sends country but the ORIGINAL provision did not, so a repaired org can end up with different country/currency than a normally-provisioned one.

Behaviour: db.insert(veridianCredentials)...onConflictDoNothing() (organization_id is the PK, so the second writer no-ops). Then re-reads via getVeridianApiKey() and refuses to report success if it comes back null.
Failure_Mode: Insert throws -> 500 'We connected your workspace but couldn''t save the connection.' Verification returns null -> 500 'We connected your workspace but couldn''t confirm it.'
Gap_Or_Risk: The loser of the race leaves one orphaned VERIDIAN org (acknowledged in-file as an acceptable tradeoff). No cleanup exists for these.

Step_Or_Surface: Resume path 1: deferred provisioning on login
Trigger: User signs in with password and has NO memberships row
Behaviour: Reads window.localStorage 'projexa_pending_org_name'; if present, POSTs /api/org/provision and removes the key on success.
Failure_Mode: On !res.ok, sets the error inline and returns without navigating.
Gap_Or_Risk: Only fires if the pending name survives in THIS browser's localStorage. If it is absent, the user is silently pushed to /dashboard with no organization at all and every API answers 'No organization' (400).

Step_Or_Surface: Resume path 2: deferred provisioning on the email-confirm callback
Trigger: User clicks the emailed confirmation link
Behaviour: After establishing the session, reads 'projexa_pending_org_name' and POSTs /api/org/provision before navigating. In-file: without this block a confirming user 'arrives at /dashboard authenticated but with no organization at all'.
Failure_Mode: On failure shows 'Your email is confirmed, but we could not finish setting up your organisation. Sign in to retry.'
Gap_Or_Risk: Same localStorage dependency. The confirmation link is usually opened in a mail client / different browser - precisely the case where localStorage is empty.

Step_Or_Surface: Middleware exception that keeps the resume path reachable
Behaviour: Normally an authenticated visitor to /login or /signup is redirected to /dashboard. EXCEPTION: for /login only, middleware first looks up memberships; if none, it lets the request through so login/page.tsx's resume logic can run. /signup gets no such exception.
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: Correct and load-bearing - but it means an authenticated user with no org can never reach /signup to name one. Their ONLY route is /login plus surviving localStorage.

Behaviour: Closed set VeridianErrorCode = UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT | UPSTREAM_500 | STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE | NETWORK. `code` is null for 4xx and for local config errors thrown by resolveApiKey(). VeridianApiError carries message (user-safe), detail (server-only), ruleCode, missing, body, durationMs.
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: AR-04's throw carries code=null and status 500, so downstream retry logic (RETRYABLE_CODES in veridian-response.ts) cannot distinguish 'this org is unprovisioned forever' from a generic server error.

Trigger: Every non-/api, non-asset page request via middleware
Behaviour: requiresAuthenticatedPage() returns false for /api/*, for any path whose last segment contains a '.', and for the public set. PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS = {'/','/hi','/how-it-works','/hi/how-it-works','/login','/signup'}. PUBLIC_PAGE_PREFIXES = ['/auth/','/invite/','/share/','/shared/'].
Failure_Mode: Forgetting an entry fails CLOSED (page redirects to /login) rather than open. page-access.test.ts regenerates both sets from the filesystem.
Gap_Or_Risk: Replaced a hand-written PROTECTED_PREFIXES allowlist under which 'roughly half the navigable product sat outside the gate' - including /copilot, listed under the stale name /ai-copilot. In-file: 'this is a GATE, not a data boundary'.

Behaviour: export const dynamic='force-static'; revalidate=3600. Renders <LandingPage locale="en" />. Zero request-time reads - the logged-in redirect moved to middleware (R67 J-01 / audit R-246).
Failure_Mode: Authenticated visitors are redirected to /dashboard by middleware's isLandingRoute() check before this page renders.
Gap_Or_Risk: Before J-01, warm TTFB was 1375ms / FCP 1672ms because one cookie read made the whole route dynamic - the warm paint was slower than the cold one.

Trigger: Hindi-locale visitor requests / (middleware REWRITES, never redirects)
Behaviour: force-static, revalidate 3600. Wraps <LandingPage locale="hi"/> in MarketingLocaleProvider. generateMetadata() pulls title/description from Marketing.hero in messages/hi.json.
Failure_Mode: A logged-in visitor reaching /hi directly is redirected to /dashboard first (isLandingRoute covers it).
Gap_Or_Risk: Exists only because a statically cached document cannot vary by cookie. The first cut of J-01 'silently retired a COMPLETE shipped Hindi translation' by serving English to everyone.

Behaviour: force-static, revalidate 3600. Renders <HowItWorksContent locale="en"/>. Exports metadata with a fixed title/description. Explicitly NOT redirect-gated by auth state, unlike /.
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: None found.

Behaviour: force-static, revalidate 3600. MarketingLocaleProvider + HowItWorksContent locale='hi'. generateMetadata() from Marketing.howItWorks.hero.
Failure_Mode: N/A
Gap_Or_Risk: None found.

Behaviour: 'use client'. supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({email,password}). On success, checks memberships; runs the deferred-provisioning resume; then router.push('/dashboard') + router.refresh().
Failure_Mode: loginError || !data.session -> inline setError(loginError?.message ?? t('genericError')).
Gap_Or_Risk: CONFIRMED DEFECT: this page never reads the `redirectTo` query param. grep for 'redirectTo' in login/page.tsx and signup/page.tsx returns NOTHING. Both middleware (url.searchParams.set('redirectTo', ...)) and the invite page send users here with redirectTo - and all of them are dumped on /dashboard instead, losing their destination.

Step_Or_Surface: Public page 5a: /login has no account-recovery affordance
Behaviour: The form renders exactly two fields (email, password), one submit button, and one link: 'no account? /signup'. There is no 'forgot password' link, no magic-link option, and no passwordless alternative.
Failure_Mode: N/A - the affordance does not exist.
Gap_Or_Risk: See PART C. Password is the ONLY authentication method offered by this page and there is no recovery from it.

Behaviour: 'use client'. Three fields: orgName (required), email (required), password (required, minLength 6). Always creates a NEW organization via /api/org/provision.
Failure_Mode: signUpError shown inline; provision failure shown inline via body.error.
Gap_Or_Risk: Signup is hardwired to 'found a new company'. There is NO 'join an existing organisation' path here. An invited person with no account cannot register through /signup without first provisioning a redundant org of their own.

Trigger: Any emailed Supabase auth link: signup confirmation, magic link, or password recovery
Behaviour: Client-side by design. Parses the URL FRAGMENT (#access_token/#refresh_token -> setSession), ?code (-> exchangeCodeForSession), or ?token_hash+?type (-> verifyOtp for magiclink|signup|recovery|invite|email_change|email). Then getSession() to confirm the cookie is durable before navigating.
Failure_Mode: No credential present -> 'This sign-in link is missing its credential. Request a new one.' Supabase error_description surfaced verbatim. Session not persisted -> 'Signed in, but the session did not persist. Check that cookies are enabled.'
Gap_Or_Risk: R47_AUTH_REDIRECT_01: PROJEXA had NO auth callback route at all until 2026-08-25, so 'a real user could not confirm an email address or complete a password reset AT ALL' - invisible because every automated test since R33 mints tokens directly and 'has never once followed an emailed link'.

Behaviour: router.replace(target.startsWith('/') && !target.startsWith('//') ? target : '/dashboard') - same-origin paths only.
Failure_Mode: A crafted absolute or protocol-relative URL falls back to /dashboard.
Gap_Or_Risk: This route DOES honour redirectTo; /login does not. The two entry points behave inconsistently.

Behaviour: MUST use createBrowserClient()'s own @supabase/ssr cookie encoder (base64url + 3180-byte chunking). In-file: hand-writing those cookies produces the '[middleware] getClaims() threw: Expected "," or "}" after property value in JSON' error group.
Failure_Mode: Malformed chunked cookie -> middleware getClaims() throws -> caught and degraded to 'logged out for this one request'.
Gap_Or_Risk: Documented landmine for anyone adding a second session-writing path.

Behaviour: 'use client'. Checks getSession(), then GETs /api/org/invites/preview?token=. Renders 'Join <org> as <role>'. ROLE_LABEL maps owner|admin|pm|site_engineer|member|client_viewer to display names. Signed in -> 'Join' button POSTs /api/org/invites/accept. Not signed in -> button to /login?redirectTo=/invite/<token>.
Failure_Mode: Preview !res.ok -> shows the server's message or 'This invitation link is not valid.' is_open false -> 'This invitation is no longer open. It has been used, revoked, or has expired.'
Gap_Or_Risk: BROKEN LOOP: the 'Sign in to accept' button sends the user to /login?redirectTo=/invite/<token>, but login/page.tsx ignores redirectTo and pushes /dashboard. The invitee never returns to the invite and must find the original link again.

Step_Or_Surface: Public page 8a: invitee with no account has no path
Trigger: Invited person has never used PROJEXA
Behaviour: The page offers only 'Sign in to accept'. There is no 'create an account to accept' branch.
Failure_Mode: The invitee goes to /signup, which forces them to name a company and provisions a whole new org + VERIDIAN tenant for them.
Gap_Or_Risk: MAJOR ONBOARDING GAP: accept_org_invite() requires a public.profiles row whose email matches the invite. A brand-new invitee must first self-signup (creating a junk org and a real, billed VERIDIAN tenant), then locate the invite link again, then accept - ending up with two memberships.

Trigger: Anyone with the token URL, no credentials of any kind
Behaviour: Server Component. Plain unauthenticated fetch to `${VERIDIAN_ORIGIN}/api/reports/share/${token}` - deliberately NOT callVeridian/callVeridianRaw, which would resolve an API key first. Renders work_progress or project_status reports. Money formatted with NO currency code (no session -> no org currency, and 'a currency is never guessed').
Failure_Mode: !res.ok or unrecognised reportType -> notFound().
Gap_Or_Risk: AR-10 'render, never authorise': no sidebar, no nav, no link back into the product. The token is a pure bearer credential - anyone holding the URL sees BOQ lines, budgets, vendor names and vendor amounts. Expiry is enforced upstream in VERIDIAN, not here.

Behaviour: Same shape and same rules as /share/report. Hits the SAME upstream endpoint /api/reports/share/[token] and explicitly rejects a payload whose reportType !== 'attendance_summary' so a work-progress token cannot be half-rendered here. Renders 'Shared, read-only -- expires automatically'. Uses formatNumber() to pin the locale.
Failure_Mode: Wrong reportType or !res.ok -> null -> notFound().

Step_Or_Surface: The only related artifact: rotate-demo-password-r38 edge function
Trigger: Operator manually invokes the deployed Supabase Edge Function with ?secret=&userId=
Behaviour: Deno.serve handler. Generates 24 random bytes -> password 'R38-<48 hex chars>' entirely inside the function, calls admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(userId,{password:newPassword}) with the injected SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, then inserts a security_audit_log row {event:'demo_password_rotated', target_user_id, target_email, actor:'rotate-demo-password-r38', metadata:{trigger:'manual_invoke'}}.
Failure_Mode: secret mismatch -> 401 {error:'unauthorized'}. Missing userId -> 400. updateUserById error -> 500 {error, step:'updateUserById'}. Audit insert failure -> returns auditLogged:false but does NOT unwind the rotation.
Gap_Or_Risk: NOT A RECOVERY PATH. It is R38 Q1 demo-credential hygiene: the new password 'never leaves this function' and is 'never returned, never logged' - so the user whose password was just rotated has no way to learn it. It cannot restore access to anyone.

Step_Or_Surface: Security risk in the only password-adjacent tool
Trigger: Anyone who can reach the deployed function URL
Behaviour: Authentication is a single hardcoded query-string literal: `if (secret !== "r38-rotate-2026")`. The secret is committed to the repo in plaintext and travels in the URL.
Failure_Mode: No rate limit, no allowlist, no expiry on the secret, no rotation of the secret itself.
Gap_Or_Risk: HIGH: a shared static secret in git and in a URL (therefore in access logs, proxy logs and Referer headers) gates a service-role function that can overwrite ANY user's password by userId. It can be used to lock a real user out, not to let one in.

Step_Or_Surface: Compound failure: locked-out owner cannot repair a broken workspace

Gap_Or_Risk: Two gaps intersect: the only fix for a half-provisioned org needs an authenticated admin, and there is no way for a locked-out admin to become authenticated. A single-owner org can therefore become permanently unrecoverable without service-role DB access.
